events.author: Solver
events.name: A Friendly Warning

options.text: [character] has our thanks, but [rival] is capable of defending itself.

events.text: A messenger from the [tribe] is brought before the court, asking to see you urgently. He rode in such haste that his horse collapsed in exhaustion upon reaching the city stables. This unusual rush is to bring you a warning from [character] that a band of [tribe] is about to set out on a raid against our lands, and would not listen to reason. [character] was unable to prevent the raid, but wishes to offer us assistance in repelling the raiders as a gesture of lasting friendship between [rival] and [tribe].

events.author: Solver
events.name: Honor Among Raiders

options.text: Send our best regards to the [tribe].
Accept the loot, but return it to [rival].
I want [tribe] submission, not respect. They will have to share more with us.

events.text: A surprising message arrives from the [tribe]. They recently conducted a successful raid into [rival] territory and are now offering to share the loot with us as a sign of respect. Whatever ulterior motives [tribe] may have, their offer is certainly a real one.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Led by the Huns

options.text: We will rally the people to defend [city]. Everyone able must take up arms.
Assure the people that the army will handle both the [tribe] and the [tribe].

events.text: The [tribe] are an amalgamation of peoples, absorbing other fighters and people they invade. Whether through loyalty or bullying, the [tribe] have convinced a swath of the [tribe] fighters near [city] to join their offensive by sending a Tribe Raid against your lands.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Scourge of All Lands

requirements.label: Bold / Foolish
tip: The leader must have one of: Bold; Foolish

options.text: Attila is just a man. We will treat him as such.
The Huns will only understand the message our blades can bring.
Defend the cities. We will ride out this storm.

events.text: [character]. The name is repeated across the lands; a drumbeat of war, drawing ever closer. The newly crowned King of the [tribe] leads his people in an unrelenting wave of chaos and destruction. Fear swells like a plague. Farmers fret for their crops and seek protection from the Hunnic raiders spilling across the lands, while their rulers share dark glances over war tables as they attempt to find a way to stop this encroaching threat.
